dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Continuous, gradual 2D narrowing observed from the widest mid-thoracic region through to the posterior peduncle.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white; high-intensity reflectance across the entire visible dorsal surface.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Single high-contrast dark circular aperture at the anterior (blowhole); elongated linear mark along the posterior dorsal ridge.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Linear topological depression following the central dorsal axis along the posterior peduncle region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent, elongated vertical linear mark along the peduncle ridge, consistent with a healed scar or deep structural groove.
